reranked_evidence.title: COVID-19 pandemic in Rajasthan - Wikipedia
reranked_evidence.snippet: Ongoing COVID-19 viral pandemic in Rajasthan, India. The reason given is: **The stats of covid cases and testing is out of date. The first case of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Indian state of Rajasthan was reported on 2 March 2020 in Jaipur. The Rajasthan Health Department had confirmed a total of 29,835 cases, including 563 deaths and 21866 recoveries as of 20 July 2020.*[needs update*] All districts in the state had reported confirmed cases of which, Jaipur was the worst-affected. On 2 March 2020, an 69-year-old Italian tourist who was part of a group of 23 tourists from Italy tested positive for COVID-19. On 18 March, three people of a family tested positive for COVID-19 in Jhunjhunu which took the total cases to seven in the state. On April 4, first death of the state was reported in Bikaner, as a 60-year-old woman died due to the virus.
